# Backend Acceptance V1

**Status:** GENERATED BY DETERMINISTIC TEST SUITE  
**Date:** 2026-09-09

The 22-case backend control-path suite covers health, pagination, safe filtering and sorting, project presence/absence, observed-only history, aggregate-only and missing-source months, unavailable prediction, prediction/alert separation, review-policy absence, server-owned assistant evidence, document routing, assistant/project failures, strict requests, disabled assistant, loader idempotency, transactional rejection, and database abstention constraints. Exact results are reported by `tests/test_backend_integration_v1.py` and must be refreshed whenever the contract changes.
